note: Glossify Node provides the glossify_node text-format filter ('Glossify: Tooltips with nodes'), a GlossifyBase subclass that turns published node titles into links/tooltips (tooltip text = node body). Settings (prefixed glossify_node_*): case_sensitivity, first_only, ignore_tags, type (tooltips|links|tooltips_links), tooltip_truncate, bundles (source content types, ;-joined, required when enabled), urlpattern (default /node/[id]), synonyms_field. Query tag glossify_node_tooltip. Config lives in filter.format.<format> -> filters.glossify_node.settings. Trivial-submodule tiers (3 easy / 1 medium / 1 hard). Medium reads a configured glossify_node filter (which content type + urlpattern); hard enables the filter on a namespaced format to link Article titles. Config-based (no rendering, since drush render hits a core theme-registry limit on this shared site). Fixtures create/tear down their own gl_node_* text formats.

evals.prompt: Which text-format filter does the glossify_node module add, what does it auto-link, and where do you enable it?
evals.expected_output: It adds the 'Glossify: Tooltips with nodes' filter (id glossify_node), which turns published node titles of the selected content types into links to those nodes and/or hover tooltips (from the node body). Enable it on a text format at /admin/config/content/formats.

evals.prompt: When enabling the glossify_node filter, which setting is required, and what is the default URL pattern used for the generated links?
evals.expected_output: You must select at least one source content type (glossify_node_bundles) - it is required when the filter is enabled. The default URL pattern is /node/[id], where [id] is replaced by the node id.

evals.prompt: In the glossify_node filter, where does the tooltip text come from, and how can other modules exclude certain nodes from the term source?
evals.expected_output: The tooltip text is the node's body field (node__body). The term-source query is tagged glossify_node_tooltip, so other modules can alter/exclude nodes via hook_query_glossify_node_tooltip_alter().

evals.prompt: The text format 'gl_node_known' has the glossify_node filter enabled. Inspect its configuration and report which content type is used as the source of titles and the URL pattern the links use.
evals.expected_output: The glossify_node filter on gl_node_known has glossify_node_bundles = 'article' and glossify_node_urlpattern = '/wiki/[id]' (type links). Read via drush cget filter.format.gl_node_known filters.glossify_node.

evals.prompt: On this site there is a text format 'gl_node_build'. Using the glossify_node module, configure it so that titles of Article content are automatically turned into links to those articles in text using this format. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the glossify_node filter on filter.format.gl_node_build with glossify_node_type = 'links' (or tooltips_links) and glossify_node_bundles including 'article'.
